steps.label: HARD THRESHOLD
steps.sub: one line — cross it, it fails

steps.label: TOLERANCE BAND
steps.sub: a range — too high or too low both alert

code:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS TotalOrders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ShippingAddress IS NULL
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MissingAddress
FROM dbo.Orders
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ShippingAddress IS NULL
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 50;
caption: Returns a row only when the threshold is actually crossed — zero rows back means no alert.

code:
SELECT
    CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AS CheckDate,
    COUNT(*) AS TodayOrderCount
FROM dbo.Orders
WHERE CAST(OrderDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
HAVING COUNT(*) NOT BETWEEN 950 AND 1050;
caption: A row comes back only when today's count falls outside the expected range — either direction.

subtitle: Turning every rule into something that runs itself.
